'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Brian Herold DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Return of FAVRE
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
